# BIDD - Belgrade Initiative for Digital and Public Diplomacy

> > BIDD is a Serbian NGO advancing digital and public diplomacy strategies for Serbia and the Balkans through cultural soft power, international engagement, and strategic communication.

BIDD focuses on leveraging Serbia's cultural assets, sports figures, and digital platforms to strengthen the country's international image and diplomatic influence. The organization analyzes global diplomacy trends, including soft power strategies from major powers, while promoting Serbia's interests in regional and international affairs.

## Key Topics

- Public Diplomacy
- Digital Diplomacy
- Soft Power
- Serbia
- Cultural Diplomacy
- Sports Diplomacy
- International Relations
- Digital Communication
- Balkans
- NATO and Sovereignty
- Modern Propaganda
- AI Integration
- Diplomatic Protocol
- Serbian Culture
- Social Media Strategy

## Serbia's Soft Power & Cultural Diplomacy

- [Emir Kusturica as Ambassador of Serbian Culture Worldwide](https://www.bidd.org.rs/naslov-emir-kusturica-ambasador-srpske-kulture-u-svetu): Emir Kusturica as Serbian cultural ambassador through film and diplomacy
- [Nikola Jokić and Serbia's Soft Power: How NBA MVP Strengthens Our Country's Image](https://www.bidd.org.rs/nikola-jokic-meka-moc-srbije): NBA MVP Nikola Jokić as symbol of Serbia's soft power and diplomacy
- [Novak Djokovic and Serbia's Soft Power](https://www.bidd.org.rs/novak-djokovic-and-serbias-soft-power): Novak Djokovic's influence on Serbia's international soft power image
- [Novak Đoković and Serbia's Soft Power (Serbian)](https://www.bidd.org.rs/novak-dokovic-i-meka-moc-srbije): Novak Đoković's sports success strengthening Serbia's digital diplomacy
- [Gujon: Virtual Museum 'Heritage of Serbia' Captivates Japanese Audience](https://www.bidd.org.rs/%d0%b3%d1%83%d1%98%d0%be%d0%bd-%d0%b2%d0%b8%d1%80%d1%82%d1%83%d0%b0%d0%bb%d0%bd%d0%b8-%d0%bc%d1%83%d0%b7%d0%b5%d1%98-%d0%bd%d0%b0%d1%81%d0%bb%d0%b5%d0%b6%d0%b5-%d1%81%d1%80%d0%b1%d0%b8%d1%98): Serbian virtual museum Heritage of Serbia presented at Osaka Expo
